text:
Hi team,

This is the short report about the customer visit last Thursday. We already reach the office at nine, but the client still not ready because their manager was in another meeting. While we waited, the receptionist bring us coffee and open the air conditioner in the small room. The manager very busy that morning, so we only had forty minutes with him. He said the old system cannot support their new branches, and all the staffs complain about the slow reports every month.

He asked us to revert back with a written quotation before Friday. One of the reason is that their finance team closes the budget at the end of this month. I explained that our price is same like last year, and he looked happy about that. He also asked whether we can to train six of their clerks in one day. I said yes, but I want to discuss about the training room with you first, because there have only one projector in that office. Please borrow me your checklist so I can prepare the material tonight.

For the next step, I suggest we send the quotation on Wednesday and call them on Thursday. If they will agree, we can start the work in the first week of June. The installation take about ten days, and the testing needs one more week after that. I already send the draft timeline to Aisha, and she will check the holiday dates. Please tell me your opinion before Tuesday evening, because I want to print the document early.

Two more small thing. The client asked whether our support team work on Saturday, and I said only the morning shift. He also wants a monthly report that show the number of tickets by branch. I think we can to build that report with the tool we already have. Last year we do something similar for the Johor client, so we can reuse the template. Rina keep the old files in the shared drive, and she will send you the link today. Please check back the numbers of the last quarter before we show anything to the client.

Thanks,
Farid
